senses.gloss:
रोध रोध, i. e. रुध् + अ, m.
 1. Obstruction, Kir. 5, 15.
 2. A bank, a shore.
 --Comp.

रोधन रोधन, i. e. रुध् + अन,
 I. adj. That which obstructs.
 II. m. The planet Mercury.
 III. n.
 1. Obstructing.
 2. Besieging.

रोधस् रोधस्, i. e. रुध् + अस्, n.
 1. A bank, a shore, Vikr. d. 8.
 2. The brink of a well, Bhāg. P. 9, 19, 4.
 3. The flank, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 29.
ऽरोधिन् -रोधिन्, i. e. रुध् + इन्, adj. Stopping, Rājat. 5, 346; Śāk. d. 135.

रोध्र रोध्र, i. e.
 I. रुध् + र, n.
 1. Sin.
 2. Offence.
 II. Probably akin to रुधिर, m. A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing, Ragh. 2, 29.
